messages:
maria: Need to lock down a cross-lang approach for pagination + retries that doesn't leak transport details. Quick thoughts: a small Pager abstraction + a Policy object.

dan: Agree. Two main resume models we discussed earlier: (A) single opaque token (base64 with prefix) and (B) server-side session-id. Both have tradeoffs.

violet: For clients that go offline, opaque tokens are better. For active low-latency streams, a short-lived server session-id is nicer. Suggest hybrid: session-id for active stream, opaque token for long-lived resume.

raj: On retry semantics we should expose an SDK Policy with fields: max_retries, backoff_strategy, idempotency_hint. SDKs translate that into transport headers or gRPC semantics. Default: conservative for non-idempotent.

maria: Token layout proposal (envelope JSON encoded then base64, prefixed): e.g. prefix "r2:" + base64({"v":2,"kind":"pager","seq":1234,"shard":"eu-1","chk":"af12","dbg":"zone=eu model=gpt-sm"}). Keep dbg optional and short so ops can troubleshoot.

dan: Important: server must return TOKEN_VERSION_MISMATCH error code when it can't decode; SDK surfaces a clear error and link to migration docs. Consider optional token-exchange endpoint to refresh tokens.

violet: Language ergonomics: TS -> AsyncIterable, Python -> async generator + sync helper, Go -> (<-chan Item, cancel func). We'll publish adapter examples in RFC.

raj: Telemetry/budget hints: prefer to expose via Console/observability but add an opt-in read-only Session.getBudget() for advanced users. Do not let clients mutate session internals.

maria: Security note: do not include PII in dbg. Servers should scrub sensitive routing info before handing tokens to clients.

dan: Tests: build cross-lang matrix: resume across model fallback, region failover, mid-stream downgrade, token version bump. CI should run these on PR.

ci-bot: queued job 'pager-resume-compat-matrix' scheduled to run on merge.

violet: Next steps: raj draft Policy shape, dan draft token envelope + error codes, maria author RFC with example adapters and migration plan.

maria: keep defaults simple: opaque tokens by default, session-id only for explicit streaming opts, clear errors for unsupported tokens, debug opt-in.

ci-bot: Reminder: please add unit tests for token decode/encode and lawyer-review for any dbg fields containing metadata.
